slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Understanding APIs
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **Understanding APIs**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

Define what an **API** is.
Explain the role of an **API** as a connector.
Identify how **prompts** are sent via **APIs**.
Apply **API** keys for authentication.

slides.title: What is an API? A Digital Waiter
slides.narration:
Have you ever wondered how different apps talk to each other?
An **API**, or **Application Programming Interface**, is a set of rules.
It lets different software applications communicate smoothly.
Think of an **API** like a waiter in a restaurant.
You give your order, or **request**, to the waiter.
The waiter takes it to the kitchen, which is the server.
Then, they bring back your food, which is the **response**.
This digital waiter helps apps work together effortlessly.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a waiter connecting a customer (app) to the kitchen (server) with digital elements

slides.title: Prompts: Your Order to the AI
slides.narration:
Now, how do you tell an **AI** what you want?
**Prompts** are your specific instructions or questions.
You send these **prompts** to an **AI** model using an **API**.
Imagine you are at a restaurant, looking at the menu.
A **prompt** is like ordering a specific dish from that menu.
You tell the kitchen exactly what you desire.
This ensures the **AI** understands your request clearly.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a person ordering food from a menu with thought bubbles showing a prompt

slides.title: API Keys: Your Access Pass
slides.narration:
What stops just anyone from using an **API**?
**API** keys are special credentials.
They are used for authentication and authorization.
This ensures only authorized users can access the **API**.
Think of an **API** key as a VIP pass.
It's like a reservation number for an exclusive service.
This pass grants you access to use the **API**.
It keeps your interactions with **AI** secure.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a VIP pass or a key unlocking a digital gate

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We defined what **APIs** are and their function.
We saw how **APIs** connect different applications.
We understood the role of **prompts** and **API** keys.
Finally, we explored sending **requests** to **AI** models.

slides.narration:

Then, print the received **response**.
